_comment: Copy this file to manifest.json in the same folder. Every 'url' below is either a confirmed-live listing/index page (verified via web search on 2026-09-13) or explicitly marked VERIFY-AND-FILL where I could not confirm a stable official link myself — never treat a VERIFY-AND-FILL placeholder as real metadata. Fill in publication_date/effective_date by reading them off the actual document, not from this file. See docs/SOURCE_ACQUISITION_GUIDE.md for the full walkthrough.

patents_act_1970.pdf.title: The Patents Act, 1970 (Act No. 39 of 1970) — REPLACE with the exact amendment date printed on the copy you downloaded
patents_act_1970.pdf.authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
patents_act_1970.pdf.summary: Primary Indian statute governing patentability, including Section 3(p) traditional-knowledge exclusion and Section 3(e) mere-admixture exclusion.

patent_rules_2024.pdf.title: The Patents (Amendment) Rules, 2024
patent_rules_2024.pdf.summary: 2024 amendments to the Patent Rules, 2003 (procedural changes to filing, examination, working statements).

trade_marks_act_1999.pdf.title: The Trade Marks Act, 1999
trade_marks_act_1999.pdf.summary: Governs trademark registration; relevant Nice Classification Class 5 (medicinal) vs Class 3 (cosmetic) for AYUSH brands, and Section 9(1)(b) descriptiveness bar.

designs_act_2000.pdf.title: The Designs Act, 2000
designs_act_2000.pdf.summary: Protects novel packaging/container shapes and visual features for AYUSH products.

gi_act_1999.pdf.title: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999
gi_act_1999.pdf.summary: Protects region/community-linked medicinal plant or product names.

copyright_act_1957.pdf.title: The Copyright Act, 1957 (as amended)
copyright_act_1957.pdf.summary: Relevant to published research/formulary content, labelling and packaging text.

ppvfr_act_2001.pdf.title: The Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001
ppvfr_act_2001.pdf.authority: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority
ppvfr_act_2001.pdf.summary: Governs registration of new medicinal plant varieties (DUS criteria).

biological_diversity_act_2002.pdf.title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002
biological_diversity_act_2002.pdf.summary: Regulates access to Indian biological resources and ABS obligations; Section 6 requires NBA approval before obtaining IPR based on a biological resource obtained from India.

biological_diversity_amendment_2023.pdf.title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
biological_diversity_amendment_2023.pdf.summary: Amends the 2002 Act (fast-tracks certain research/AYUSH processes, adjusts exemptions).

biological_diversity_rules_2024.pdf.title: The Biological Diversity Rules, 2024
biological_diversity_rules_2024.pdf.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change / NBA
biological_diversity_rules_2024.pdf.summary: Supersedes the Biological Diversity Rules, 2004; implements the 2023 Amendment Act; sets out NBA approval, penalty, and online-application procedures.

nba_abs_guidelines.pdf.title: NBA Access and Benefit Sharing Guidelines (Form I / Form III, benefit-sharing schedule)
nba_abs_guidelines.pdf.summary: IMPORTANT: read the current benefit-sharing percentage directly from this document before using it anywhere — do not trust any percentage figure from a secondary source.

drugs_cosmetics_act_1940.pdf.title: The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules, 1945 (Chapter IV-A, Schedule T, Rule 158-B)
drugs_cosmetics_act_1940.pdf.authority: Ministry of AYUSH & Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO)
drugs_cosmetics_act_1940.pdf.summary: Governs licensing and classification of classical/proprietary Ayurvedic drugs, GMP (Schedule T).

new_drugs_clinical_trials_rules_2019.pdf.title: New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 (phytopharmaceutical pathway)
new_drugs_clinical_trials_rules_2019.pdf.summary: Defines the phytopharmaceutical drug category and its clinical-evidence requirements, distinct from classical/proprietary AYUSH licensing.

drugs_magic_remedies_act_1954.pdf.title: The Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
drugs_magic_remedies_act_1954.pdf.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
drugs_magic_remedies_act_1954.pdf.summary: Restricts advertising claims for AYUSH products — relevant to the 'claims'/'intended use' fields in product analysis.

fssai_ayurveda_aahar_2022.pdf.title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahar) Regulations, 2022
fssai_ayurveda_aahar_2022.pdf.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), with Ministry of AYUSH
fssai_ayurveda_aahar_2022.pdf.summary: Regulates Ayurveda-Aahar food products; distinguishes food from drug claims.

dpdp_act_2023.pdf.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
dpdp_act_2023.pdf.source: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
dpdp_act_2023.pdf.summary: Not a citation source for user answers — this is for your own system's privacy/audit compliance posture per the problem statement's DPDP-alignment requirement.

wipo_pct.pdf.title: Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) and Applicant's Guide
wipo_pct.pdf.summary: International patent filing route; relevant to export/international jurisdiction queries.

wipo_gratk_treaty_2024.pdf.title: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
wipo_gratk_treaty_2024.pdf.summary: Adopted May 2024 — confirm current ratification/entry-into-force status before stating it is 'in force' for any specific country; requires disclosure of genetic-resource/TK origin in patent applications.

nagoya_protocol.pdf.title: Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and the Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits
nagoya_protocol.pdf.summary: International ABS framework underlying India's Biological Diversity Act obligations.

budapest_treaty.pdf.title: Budapest Treaty on the International Recognition of the Deposit of Microorganisms
budapest_treaty.pdf.summary: Relevant only if a formulation involves a deposited microbial strain (e.g. a fermentation-derived ingredient).
